verdict.rationale: Bolt allows direct code editing in Code view, GitHub export/sync (create a new repo from a project, full commit history living outside Bolt), and since it's built on StackBlitz WebContainers, projects run standard npm/Node.js stacks that can be run/hosted independently outside the platform. Missing for 10: no explicit one-click 'download zip' export mention or independent verification that exported repos run flawlessly outside Bolt without platform-specific dependencies.
